literal.prompt: Какова была основная цель плана ГОЭЛРО?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library identifies GOELRO as the plan of the State Commission for Electrification of Russia (L44), directly supporting the unique answer «Электрификация страны». The other answers name distinct agricultural and market-policy programs: collectivization (Presidential Library L44-L51), restrictions on free trade in the 1947 reform period (retained Presidential Library L51), and the 1954 virgin-land resolution (GARF L83). These facts distinguish those options from the electrification plan rather than treating their different historical contexts as proof of the key.
finalGroupBindings.locator: turn0view0 L44; turn5view0 L44-L51; retained turn4view0 L51; turn4view0 L83

finalGroupBindings.literal: План ГОЭЛРО задал общегосударственную программу электрификации Советской России. Он связал развитие энергетики с единым планированием народного хозяйства, а комиссия ГОЭЛРО стала прообразом Госплана.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library says GOELRO established the basis of the national planning system (L44), and Gosplan was tasked with a unified national economic plan based on electrification (L43-L45); it also dates the Commission and identifies it as the prototype of Gosplan (L44).

finalGroupBindings.literal: К 1 июля 1930 года в колхозы объединили 23,6% крестьянских хозяйств.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library records that by 1 July 1930, kolkhozes included 23.6% of peasant households, providing a specific factual note about the agricultural collectivization option.

finalGroupBindings.literal: После реформы 1947 года нормы ограничивали свободную торговлю до 1958 года, а для части товаров — до 1963-го.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The retained complete Presidential Library page says the 1947 sales norms restricted free trade through 1958 and, for some goods, through 1963. This makes the note a concrete historical fact about the free-trade-policy option.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Мартовский пленум ЦК КПСС 1954 года принял постановление об освоении целинных и залежных земель.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The State Archive page identifies the March 1954 Central Committee plenum resolution on increasing grain production and cultivating virgin and fallow lands.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Комиссия по электрификации России работала в 1920–1921 годах и стала прообразом Госплана.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The Presidential Library dates the electrification commission’s work to 1920-1921 and says it became the prototype of the State General Planning Commission (Gosplan). The dates add a concrete fact beyond the answer «Электрификация страны».

The note gives a concrete 1930 statistic about this option.
